# `silk/time/offset`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Fixed offsets from UTC: the [`UtcOffset`](#UtcOffset) type.

## When to use

Use [`UtcOffset`](#UtcOffset) for the `+01:00` part of a timestamp: how far a local clock is ahead of or
behind UTC at one moment. It is not a time zone. A zone such as `Europe/Rome` has different
offsets in summer and in winter.

## Details

An offset is a whole number of seconds east of UTC, less than 24 hours in each direction.
Local time is UTC plus the offset, so `17:00` at `+01:00` is `16:00` UTC.

## Examples

### Parse an offset and read it

```silk
import silk.core.result { Result }
import silk.time.offset { UtcOffset }
import silk.time.text { TimeParseError }

pub fn main() -> i32 {
  match UtcOffset.parse("-03:30") {
    Result<UtcOffset, TimeParseError>.Success { value } => {
      if value.totalSeconds() != -12600 {
        return 1
      }
      return 0
    }
    Result<UtcOffset, TimeParseError>.Failure { error: _ } => {
      return 2
    }
  }
}
```

Import as `UtcOffset` with `import silk.time.offset { UtcOffset }`.

## `UtcOffset`

```silk
pub struct UtcOffset
```

A fixed offset from UTC in whole seconds, less than 24 hours in each direction.

### Details

The offset is positive east of UTC: local time is UTC plus the offset. `==`, `!=`, `<`, `<=`,
`>`, and `>=` compare the number of seconds. `Display` writes `+HH:MM`, or `+HH:MM:SS` when the
offset has a seconds part.

pub fn fromSeconds(seconds: i32) -> UtcOffset

Returns the offset of `seconds` seconds east of UTC, or west for a negative count.

#### Gotchas

An offset of 24 hours or more traps. [`UtcOffset.checkedFromSeconds`](#UtcOffset.impl.checkedFromSeconds) returns `None` instead.

<a id="UtcOffset.impl.parse"></a>

### Associated function `parse`

```silk
pub fn parse(text: string) -> Result<UtcOffset, TimeParseError>
```

Reads an offset from text such as `+01:00`, `-0330`, or `Z`.

#### Details

The text is `Z` or `z` for UTC, or a sign and `HH`, `HH:MM`, `HHMM`, `HH:MM:SS`, or `HHMMSS`.

#### Errors

- `TimeParseReason.UnexpectedEnd` or `UnexpectedCharacter` if the text does not have that
  form.
- `TimeParseReason.OutOfRange` if the hour is above 23 or the minute or second is above 59.

## Implementation `Display for UtcOffset`

```silk
impl Display for UtcOffset
```

Writes the offset as `+HH:MM`, or `+HH:MM:SS` when it has a seconds part, with `-` west of UTC.
The zero offset is `+00:00`.
